payout_quote: Open a checking account and earn 1% APY*, plus earn $250 for meeting direct deposit requirements***
steps: Open a new primary checking account at ValleyStar Credit Union (open a savings account with a $1 deposit to establish membership; no initial deposit needed for checking)

Set up direct deposit; have your first direct deposit post within 90 days of account opening, then maintain three consecutive months of recurring monthly direct deposit of net pay, pension, or government benefits totaling $1,000 or more per month (within 150 days of account opening)

Keep the account open and in good standing; ValleyStar deposits the $250 into the checking account after three months of consistent $1,000 direct deposits (credited within 180 days of account opening)
catches: High direct-deposit bar: $1,000+ per month in net pay, pension, or government benefits for three consecutive months
Recurring transfers or deposits from other accounts at ValleyStar or other institutions do NOT qualify - must be payroll/pension/government-benefit direct deposit
First direct deposit must post within 90 days of account opening and the three consecutive months must be completed within 150 days
Members who closed a ValleyStar checking account within two years of the new account open date are ineligible
One bonus per member / distinct Social Security number; additional checking accounts are not eligible
Accounts must be open and in good standing at the time of payout; taxes on bonuses are the recipient's responsibility
Bonus is credited within 180 days of account opening - a long wait
The 1% APY mentioned alongside is only on the $500-$10,000 portion of the average monthly balance, separate from the $250 bonus
biggest_catch: You need three consecutive months of $1,000+ payroll or government-benefit direct deposits (bank transfers do not count), and the $250 may not arrive until up to 180 days after you open the account.
eligibility: New and existing ValleyStar members who open a new checking account; members who closed a checking account within the past two years are ineligible; one bonus per member/SSN.
timing: First DD within 90 days of opening; three consecutive $1,000+ months within 150 days; bonus credited after the three months, within 180 days of opening.
weasel_words: The dividend rate and APY are determined by the Credit Union's Board of Directors and are subject to change at any time

notes: The 1% APY on balances ($500-$10,000) is an ongoing account feature, not part of the bonus; it is disclosed to avoid confusing it with the $250 payout.
payout_value_note: Flat $250 direct-deposit bonus stated on the official ValleyStar page.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($250 flat); time: membership + checking account opening and DD setup est. 30-60 min active (qualification spans 3+ months)
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $250. Per official terms: First DD within 90 days of opening; three consecutive $1,000+ months within 150 days; bonus credited after the three months, within 180 days of opening. Earliest realistic: ~4.0 months (3 monthly DD cycles + the payout window).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The offer requires consecutive months of direct deposits — payroll cycles are the hard floor and cannot be compressed. Fastest honest path: set up a real payroll direct deposit immediately (Zelle/bank transfers typically don't count) and keep it running uninterrupted; a missed month restarts the clock.

speed_history.rationale: speed audit 2026-09-23: no hidden fast path in official terms — structural gate is 'multi-month-dd'
